answer: Sybil gate: echo-vested bonds. A new identity locks a time-vesting bond and earns its admission signal only as established peers countersign it; every echo is a peer staking marble-weighted reputation on the recruit. Spawning N clones needs N independent echoes from bonded peers, so attacker cost scales linearly per fake, and any peer caught vouching for fraud has its own unvested bond slashed and reputation burned.
